title: Engine response to operation: complexity (/io/response.json)
description: Complexity of what the candidate changed relative to the base, per file in changed_files: it is the Occam selection metric between builders (§5 Stage 5, N=2), lexicographic. loc_added and loc_removed are the file's diff lines. cyclomatic is the cyclomatic complexity (McCabe: 1 per function plus each decision) summed over the functions the candidate added or changed; ast_nodes, the AST nodes of those same functions. null when the file is not code for the engine or does not parse: the core does not count it as zero. A file the engine does not measure does not appear; the core lists it as unmeasured.
